name: Grothama, All-Devouring
oracle_text:
Other creatures have "Whenever this creature attacks, you may have it fight Grothama, All-Devouring."
When Grothama leaves the battlefield, each player draws cards equal to the amount of damage dealt to Grothama this turn by sources they controlled.
blocked_sentences: When Grothama leaves the battlefield, each player draws cards equal to the amount of damage dealt to Grothama this turn by sources they controlled.
Other creatures have "Whenever this creature attacks, you may have it fight Grothama, All-Devouring."

needs.what: a value expression reading the total damage dealt this turn to a specific permanent (the source, readable after it has left the battlefield, i.e. from a per-turn damage ledger keyed by object) by sources controlled by a given player, usable inside for_each_player with the iterated player as the controller (so each player draws their own share)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: damage_taken_this_turn and max_damage_taken_this_turn count damage dealt to players only, not to a permanent, and neither splits by the controller of the damage source; snapshot/toughness_had/power_had read characteristics, not damage received

needs.what: a selector, usable inside a granted triggered ability's effects, that names the permanent that granted the ability (the grant_ability static's source), so the granted trigger can say 'fight Grothama' with fight.other pointing at the granter rather than at 'self' (which on a granted trigger is the recipient)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: grantable_abilities supports triggered abilities, but inside them 'self' is the recipient; the only way to reach Grothama is a name selector, which would also match a second Grothama (e.g. a copy controlled by another player) and is not the object that granted the ability
